column1: #  - only forms at the top level of the file count; a def, var or defn inside a function, let, when or each is a local;
#  - defn, defn-, defmacro and defmacro- are functions (macros are functions); (def f (fn ..)) and (def- f (fn ..)) are functions;
#  - any other def, def-, var, var-, defglobal, varglobal or defdyn binding one plain name is a variable (def is immutable in Janet, but is held as a variable like Clojure's def);
#  - destructuring defs, import, use, calls and forms whose head only starts with def (def-macro-like-name) are not definitions.
